user_saw: A Telegram hot reload failed and requested a Gateway recovery restart when a disabled account had an unresolved SecretRef.
summary: The fix skips credential preparation for disabled idle accounts during channel teardown and preserves cleanup for previously admitted work.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already shows hot reload calling whole-channel stop, which enumerates configured accounts and resolves credentials for each account when a stop hook exists, and Telegram already had a stop hook and strict resolution for non-environment SecretRefs. I checked that the September plugin-reload change carried forward the idle credential lookup and that the later async resolver change preserved it. The available history ends before I could identify when the failing path was introduced or establish that it previously worked.
